eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Atoka, OK; at 3:30 PM on SEP 14, 2026 Effective until 5:30 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: At 1715  a large and destructive wildfire was burning out of control north of Atoka  spreading rapidly north along the west side of the Atoka Reservoir. Wildfires can damage or destroy structures and can harm or kill people and animals. For your safety  EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY to the northwest toward Lehigh. Those between Highway 69 and East Tower Road and North Coal Creek Road should LEAVE this area NOW to avoid injury or death. Do not delay to pack belongings. Evacuate towards the northwest to Lehigh. Roads in the area may be impacted by fire and smoke. Never drive into heavy smoke. SLOW DOWN & MOVE OVER for emergency vehicles.
